title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1968-10-13

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of an Avalon show that delivers a mind‑melting Dark Star, soaring Eleven and fiery Death Don’t Have No Mercy.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the musical intensity of this late‑summer 1968 performance – highlighting a near‑perfect Dark Star, a scorching The Eleven and a masterful Death Don't Have No Mercy. The soundboard source is described as good quality with clear audio, though one reviewer notes a brief splice between New Potato and Drums. Overall the show is considered exceptional despite a few weaker moments in the second set.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed, highly positive reviews (4★ and 5★) emphasize outstanding musical performance and good soundboard quality; weighted rating leans toward the high end of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced soundboard recording with no major flaws mentioned; reviewers note overall good quality across available copies.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is strong and typical of the era; second set features a superb Other One but suffers from an jarring splice into Drums. The concert ends with calming feedback/space.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Top‑notch guitar work and soulful vocal on Death Don't Have No Mercy; feeds off Phil's bass.
band_member_comments.Phil: Strong, feeding‑off interplay with Jerry that drives the band’s energy.
band_member_comments.Drums: Fabulous drumming overall, though the dedicated Drum segment was considered uninteresting.
